# Paliwal Secure — AI Insurance Advisor

> India's #1 AI-powered insurance knowledge platform. Compare 51+ IRDAI-registered insurers. Trusted by 500+ families.

## About

Paliwal Secure is an IRDAI Registered POSP (Point of Sale Person) platform founded by **Himanshu Paliwal** (POSP Code: IP429834). We provide:

- AI-powered insurance advisory via InsureGPT (24/7 chatbot)
- Side-by-side comparison of 51+ insurers (health, motor, life, travel, home)
- Free policy audit for existing insurance holders
- Claim assistance across all insurers we represent
- Hinglish/Hindi/English support

## Key Data Sources

- IRDAI Annual Report 2024-25 (Claim Settlement Ratios)
- IRDAI Motor Tariff 2025-26 (Third-Party Premium Rates)
- Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (Section 146 — Mandatory Third-Party Insurance)
- IRDAI Guidelines on Standardization of Health Insurance Products
- Insurer websites (premium estimates, network hospitals, policy wording)
